items.description: A working breakdown: StorageDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#breakdown). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import StorageDemo from components/litt/examples/breakdown-demo, or read it for how @litt/breakdown is used. Import Breakdown from components/litt/breakdown. Pass a label, the parts as { label, value } largest first, and the total when there is free space. Past five parts the rest fold into Other. Pin a hue on a part to keep a kind's color across a page.

items.name: cohort-grid-demo
items.title: Cohort grid example
items.description: A working cohort grid: WeeklyDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#cohort-grid). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import WeeklyDemo from components/litt/examples/cohort-grid-demo, or read it for how @litt/cohort-grid is used. Import CohortGrid from components/litt/cohort-grid. Pass a label and cohorts as { label, size, values }, oldest first. Each value is the share still active (0 to 100), or a count with valueType="count", and a missing or null value is a period the cohort has not reached. Set periodLabel="Month" or pass periods for other headers. Add average for an All cohorts row and pick a hue.

items.name: details-demo
items.title: Details example
items.description: A working details: DeploymentDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#details). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import DeploymentDemo from components/litt/examples/details-demo, or read it for how @litt/details is used. Import Details, DetailsItem and DetailsLink from components/litt/details. Give Details a title and one DetailsItem per fact, with copy on the values people paste. Use layout="grid" for a few short facts, and bare inside a dialog or a panel.

items.name: dot-plot-demo
items.title: Dot plot example
items.description: A working dot plot: ReplySpeedDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#dot-plot). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import ReplySpeedDemo from components/litt/examples/dot-plot-demo, or read it for how @litt/dot-plot is used. Import DotPlot from components/litt/dot-plot. Pass a label, the values, a scale (log for durations) and a formatValue. Add a goal to split the dots, markers to name outliers. It measures its container, so give it a width. Each non-empty column is reachable with the arrow keys.

items.name: funnel-demo
items.title: Funnel example
items.description: A working funnel: StoreDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#funnel). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import StoreDemo from components/litt/examples/funnel-demo, or read it for how @litt/funnel is used. Import Funnel from components/litt/funnel. Pass a label and the steps as { label, value } in the order people go through them. Every rail is measured against the first step. hue picks the one data hue (blue by default), unit or formatValue writes the numbers, overallText replaces "4.1% overall", and formatStep(value, previous) rewrites the line between steps.

items.name: gauge-demo
items.title: Gauge example
items.description: A working gauge: CreditsDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#gauge). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import CreditsDemo from components/litt/examples/gauge-demo, or read it for how @litt/gauge is used. Import Gauge from components/litt/gauge. Pass a label, a value, a max and a value text (what a screen reader hears); add a figure, a caption or a hue. It scales down to its container.

items.name: heatmap-demo
items.title: Heatmap example
items.description: A working heatmap: UsageDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#heatmap). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import UsageDemo from components/litt/examples/heatmap-demo, or read it for how @litt/heatmap is used. Import Heatmap from components/litt/heatmap. Pass a label, rows of { label, values, total? } and columns that name each column, and pick a hue. Use null for a day with no data. The dots are a grid you can arrow through.

items.name: legend-demo
items.title: Legend example
items.description: A working legend: ChartDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#legend). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import ChartDemo from components/litt/examples/legend-demo, or read it for how @litt/legend is used. Import Legend and legendHues from components/litt/legend. Pass a label and the items as { name, hue?, value? } in the chart's order, five at most. Control it with hidden and onHiddenChange, or start it with defaultHidden. Pass the chart only the shown series, each with hue: legendHues(items)[name], so a series keeps its color when another is hidden, and turn the chart's own legend off with legend={false}. Alt with a click or Enter shows only that series.

items.name: log-view-demo
items.title: Log view example
items.description: A working log view: BuildDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#log-view). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import BuildDemo from components/litt/examples/log-view-demo, or read it for how @litt/log-view is used. Import LogView and LogLine from components/litt/log-view. Append lines ({ time, level, text }) as the run writes, and give it a height. Say how the run ended in your own status; lines are not read out one by one.

items.name: range-chart-demo
items.title: Range chart example
items.description: A working range chart: VisitorsDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#range-chart). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import VisitorsDemo from components/litt/examples/range-chart-demo, or read it for how @litt/range-chart is used. Import RangeChart from components/litt/range-chart. Give it a label, bars as { label, value }, and optionally segments as { label, start }, axis ticks and a unit. Hold the range in state with value and onValueChange ([first, last], both inclusive), or load on onValueCommit, which fires once the edges have settled. The figure is a sum, so the values must add up. A single moment in a run is a TimeScrubber; a value that stays is a Slider.

items.name: sparkline-demo
items.title: Sparkline example
items.description: A working sparkline: BesideAFigureDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#sparkline). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import BesideAFigureDemo from components/litt/examples/sparkline-demo, or read it for how @litt/sparkline is used. Import Sparkline from components/litt/sparkline. Pass a label and the values, oldest first. It fills its container's width, so give a table cell a wrapper with a width, and fix min and max so rows compare. Put the exact figure beside it. Stat takes one in its trend prop.

items.name: spread-demo
items.title: Spread example
items.description: A working spread: BuildTimesDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#spread). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import BuildTimesDemo from components/litt/examples/spread-demo, or read it for how @litt/spread is used. Import Spread from components/litt/spread. Pass a label and items of { label, values } or { label, min, p25, median, p75, max }, and a formatValue that includes the unit. Rows share one scale (linear or log, with an optional domain and ticks) and an optional goal. It fills its container's width, so give the container a width.

items.name: timeline-demo
items.title: Timeline example
items.description: A working timeline: DeployDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#timeline). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import DeployDemo from components/litt/examples/timeline-demo, or read it for how @litt/timeline is used. Import Timeline, TimelinePhase, TimelineStep, TimelineResult and TimelineBar from components/litt/timeline. Put steps in phases, give each step an at, a label, a status and its seconds, and close with a TimelineResult. Feed TimelineBar the same data as the list, and keep it beside the list.

items.name: app-shell-demo
items.title: App shell example
items.description: A working app shell: ShellDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#app-shell). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import ShellDemo from components/litt/examples/app-shell-demo, or read it for how @litt/app-shell is used. Import AppShell, SidebarNav and SidebarLink from components/litt/app-shell. Pass a wordmark, a nav and the page. Mark the current link with current. It needs no router: pass as={Link} to a SidebarLink to use yours.

items.name: chart-demo
items.title: Chart example
items.description: A working chart: DeploysDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#chart). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import DeploysDemo from components/litt/examples/chart-demo, or read it for how @litt/chart is used. Import BarChart, LineChart, StackedBarChart and Meter from components/litt/chart. Pass a label, the category labels and series of { name, values }, with an optional hue per series or hues on the chart. The chart measures its container, so give it a width. Every chart ships a hidden table and a summary for screen readers.

items.name: form-demo
items.title: Form example
items.description: A working form: StartProjectDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#form). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import StartProjectDemo from components/litt/examples/form-demo, or read it for how @litt/form is used. Import FormSection, Fieldset, ErrorSummary and FormActions from components/litt/form. The fields themselves come from input, select, checkbox, switch and slider.

items.name: pagination-demo
items.title: Pagination example
items.description: A working pagination: DeploysDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#pagination). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import DeploysDemo from components/litt/examples/pagination-demo, or read it for how @litt/pagination is used. Import Pagination from components/litt/pagination. Hold the page in state and pass page, pageSize, total and onPageChange. Give it a label that says what is paged.

items.name: rolling-number-demo
items.title: Rolling number example
items.description: A working rolling number: DeploysDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#rolling-number). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import DeploysDemo from components/litt/examples/rolling-number-demo, or read it for how @litt/rolling-number is used. Import RollingNumber from components/litt/rolling-number and pass it a number as value, with Intl.NumberFormat options as format and a locale. It takes the font, size and color of where it sits: pass it as a Stat's value to roll a tile, since Stat itself stays still. A change is not announced; say it in a live region if it matters.

items.name: stat-demo
items.title: Stat example
items.description: A working stat: StudioStatsDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#stat). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import StudioStatsDemo from components/litt/examples/stat-demo, or read it for how @litt/stat is used. Import Stat and StatGroup from components/litt/stat. Say the direction in the delta's words, and set tone to good, bad or neutral for whether it is news. Put the tiles in a StatGroup: two across, four across from 40rem.

items.name: states-demo
items.title: Empty and loading states example
items.description: A working empty and loading states: EmptyDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#states). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import EmptyDemo from components/litt/examples/states-demo, or read it for how @litt/states is used. Import Empty, Skeleton, Loading and ErrorState from components/litt/states. Wrap Skeleton blocks in Loading, so a screen reader hears what is loading once.

items.name: code-block-demo
items.title: Code block example
items.description: A working code block: FilesDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#code-block). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import FilesDemo from components/litt/examples/code-block-demo, or read it for how @litt/code-block is used. Import CodeBlock from components/litt/code-block. Pass the code, a lang (tsx, ts, jsx, js, diff, shell or text) and a filename for the header. The label names the scroll area and defaults to the file name. lineNumbers adds a gutter, wrap wraps long lines, and maxHeight (a number or a CSS length) makes a tall block scroll. A diff reads each line's first character as its sign. The syntax colors are declared on the block itself, so it needs no stylesheet. It imports sugar-high.

items.name: composer-demo
items.title: Composer example
items.description: A working composer: StudioDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#composer). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import StudioDemo from components/litt/examples/composer-demo, or read it for how @litt/composer is used. Import Composer (and FileChip) from components/litt/composer. Hold the files yourself and pass onSend, streaming and onStop: the field clears after a send, and Send becomes Stop while streaming is true. Pass onFiles to show Attach and take pastes and drops, files and onRemoveFile to draw the chips, tools for a model Select at sm, suggestions for an empty chat, hint for a line under the box, and maxLength for the count. On a touch screen Return adds a line and Send sends by itself (enterSends overrides it); keep the composer above the keyboard with useVisibleScreen.

items.name: file-changes-demo
items.title: File changes example
items.description: A working file changes: TurnDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#file-changes). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import TurnDemo from components/litt/examples/file-changes-demo, or read it for how @litt/file-changes is used. Import FileChanges from components/litt/file-changes. Pass changes ({ id, path, kind, diff?, added?, removed?, from? for a rename, state? }) and onDecide(ids, decision), and set each change's state from it: the component holds no decision of its own. Use one change in an edit call's details and every change at the end of the turn.

items.name: message-demo
items.title: Message example
items.description: A working message: ThreadDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#message). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import ThreadDemo from components/litt/examples/message-demo, or read it for how @litt/message is used. Import Conversation, Message, MessageText and MessageActions from components/litt/message. Give the Conversation a label and a height, and mark it busy while the agent answers. Inside it put a Message with from="user" for the person's turn, and a Message for the agent's, holding a MessageText (your markdown renderer's output goes inside it) and actions={<MessageActions copyText onRetry />}. Pass streaming while the text arrives, and error with onRetry for a turn that stopped.

items.name: plan-demo
items.title: Plan example
items.description: A working plan: MoveDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#plan). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import MoveDemo from components/litt/examples/plan-demo, or read it for how @litt/plan is used. Import Plan from components/litt/plan. Pass a label and steps of { id, label, status, detail? }, with status one of pending, running, done, failed or skipped. Hold the steps in state and change a status in place as the agent works, and give every step a stable id so only a step you add later fades in. The count is the done steps over all steps, and failed and skipped steps do not count. It fills its container and has no card, so put it in a turn or in a panel you draw.

items.name: run-card-demo
items.title: Run card example
items.description: A working run card: WorldDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#run-card). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import WorldDemo from components/litt/examples/run-card-demo, or read it for how @litt/run-card is used. Import RunCard from components/litt/run-card. Give it a title and the run's steps as Plan takes them (label, status, an id), and optionally progress from 0 to 1, a preview, actions such as a Stop button, and open with onOpenChange. Update steps in place as the agent works. A plan with no run behind it is a Plan.

items.name: run-list-demo
items.title: Run list example
items.description: A working run list: SidebarDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#run-list). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import SidebarDemo from components/litt/examples/run-list-demo, or read it for how @litt/run-list is used. Import RunList from components/litt/run-list. Pass runs ({ id, title, status, detail?, progress?, updated, href? }) in your order, selectedId and onSelect, and onStop and onArchive for the row actions. updated is words you give ("2m ago"): the list reads no clock.

items.name: thinking-demo
items.title: Thinking example
items.description: A working thinking: LiveDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#thinking). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import LiveDemo from components/litt/examples/thinking-demo, or read it for how @litt/thinking is used. Import Thinking from components/litt/thinking. Pass active while the agent thinks and the reasoning as children: the clock counts from when active turned true. For a thought loaded from history leave active off and pass duration in seconds. open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control it, and label replaces the words.

items.name: tool-call-demo
items.title: Tool call example
items.description: A working tool call: RunDemo, the first demo on its page (https://littmd.vercel.app/#tool-call). It installs the components it uses.
items.docs: Import RunDemo from components/litt/examples/tool-call-demo, or read it for how @litt/tool-call is used. Import ToolCall, ToolCallGroup and ToolApproval from components/litt/tool-call. Give a call a status, an action and a target, plus an input or an output to make it open. Put a LogView, a SourceList or a FileChanges in details, never in output, and say what the call found in result. Pass running to a group, and hold decision in state for an approval, setting it in onAllow and onDeny. Keep an approval outside a group, and disable your Send while it waits so the view holds one accent fill.
